title: An invoiced work order with an inactive part can be viewed and printed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 20 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [WO-1] = an invoiced work order holding [Part-A] (1 × $20.00); [Part-A] set inactive after the invoice.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL OLDWO PART), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-OLDWO-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  2. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-OLDWO-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL OLDWO PART).
  3. Go to Work Orders, click "New Work Order"; in Customer click Add and create a customer (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL OLDWO Customer"); in Asset click Add and create a unit (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-OLDWO-UNIT"); click Create.
  4. [WO-1] = the work order number shown at the top left (e.g. S2-1234).
  5. On [WO-1] click "New Line", type Title (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL OLDWO line"), click "Save & Close". [Line-1] = that line. Click "Approve" on [Line-1].
  6. On [Line-1] open the line's ⋮ menu, click "Request part", type [Part-A] in Part Number, pick the row that shows "Inventory Qty", set Quantity to 1 and click "Save Part".
  7. Pick [Part-A], mark [Line-1] complete, complete [WO-1] (Review if asked), then click "Create Invoice" on the Finance tab.
  8. Set [Part-A] inactive: on the Active tab search [Part-A], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  9. Check the setup worked: [WO-1] reads Invoiced and [Part-A] is on the Inactive tab.
custom_steps:
1. Open [WO-1] and read its Lines tab.
  2. Open the Finance tab and read the invoice.
  3. Click the print icon on the Finance tab.
  4. Go to Reports → Parts Velocity, set a date range that includes today and search [Part-A].
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: [WO-1] opens and [Line-1] shows [Part-A].
  • Step 2: The invoice shows [Part-A], 1 × $20.00.
  • Step 3: The print preview opens and lists [Part-A].
  • Step 4: The report lists [Part-A] with its sold quantity 1.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S9-E4, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas none. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).
